description: Checks a board text without publishing it. Returns what the board understood, page by page, and every problem with its line and how to fix it. Fix every ERROR, then call check_board again. When there are no errors, call publish_board.

text.description: The whole board in the Math Board format: # title, ## pages, Markdown with $...$ formulas, :::graph, :::geometry, :::solid blocks, and :::comment, :::say blocks under ### step headings. The ~~~mathboard fence around it is optional.

name: check_board
title: Check a board
